[attribute-mimetype]
=== `@mimetype` Mime Type

Mime type for a graphic, multimedia object, or piece of supplementary material.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Values Best Practice

The source for this attribute’s values is the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA).
##### Element Best Practice

Although this Tag Set cannot enforce it, the element <<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>> should be limited to still images. The element <<element-media,`<media>`>> should be reserved for objects whose <<attribute-mimetype,`@mimetype`>>/<<attribute-mime-subtype,`@mime-subtype`>> involves video, audio, moving images, time-dependent graphic types, and other non-XML data types. Mimetypes and subtypes should be set accordingly but are not constrained by this Tag Set.

#### OPTIONAL on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>>, <<element-inline-graphic,`<inline-graphic>`>>, <<element-inline-media,`<inline-media>`>>, <<element-inline-supplementary-material,`<inline-supplementary-material>`>>, <<element-media,`<media>`>>, <<element-supplementary-material,`<supplementary-material>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The appropriate mime type for the object.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
